source_clauses.verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
release exactly one each time I press a lever
so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
requirements.observable_verbatim: the dispenser is mounted on a wall

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should hold about twenty of them
requirements.observable_verbatim: the dispenser holds about twenty items

requirements.statement_verbatim: release exactly one each time I press a lever
requirements.observable_verbatim: each lever press releases exactly one item

requirements.statement_verbatim: so I never get two at once.
requirements.observable_verbatim: the dispenser never releases two items at once

requirements.statement_verbatim: I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
requirements.observable_verbatim: the dispenser can be refilled from the top while it remains attached to the wall

requirements.statement_verbatim: It must not jam when it is nearly empty.
requirements.observable_verbatim: the dispenser does not jam when nearly empty

scenarios.name: Dispensing
scenarios.system_boundary: The dispenser and its contents are inside; the wall, the user, and the items being dispensed are outside.

scenarios.name: Refilling
scenarios.system_boundary: The dispenser (including its internal storage) is inside; the wall, the user, and the items being loaded are outside.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism for releasing one item at a time is unspecified.
freedoms.why_free: The text does not mention the mechanism.

freedoms.decision: The internal arrangement and materials are unspecified.
freedoms.why_free: The text does not mention them.

freedoms.decision: The exact capacity is left as an approximate band.

ambiguities.statement: What constitutes 'nearly empty' is not defined.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the threshold for 'nearly empty' is specified.

ambiguities.statement: The meaning of 'exactly one each time' is ambiguous under failure conditions (e.g., if no items are present).
ambiguities.resolvable_when: When the behavior when empty is specified.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser is intended to be operated by a single user.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If usage is meant for multiple users simultaneously.

assumptions.statement: The items are small and similar enough to be treated uniformly.
assumptions.why: The text says 'small items' and 'about twenty of them'.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If items vary greatly in size or shape.

assumptions.statement: The dispenser is meant to be refilled only by the user, not by automated means.
